exam: 101年公務人員高等考試一級暨二級考試第一試
subject: 英文（包括作文、翻譯與應用文）

essays.text:
英譯中：
①As an industry that recognizes the legitimate concerns of copyright owners that exist ina digital world, consumer-electronics companies have been working for years with boththe recording and motion picture industries on developing technological measures thatmeet the needs of both industries by protecting content at the source.（12 分）
②E-mail has become efficient to the point of counter-efficiency, threatening to overwhelmthe primary activities---teaching, reading, writing, and thinking---that we once hoped itmight help sustain. The best teaching and writing require some professional spacewithin which to give the illusion of inefficiency. E-mail’s demand for metronomicefficiency threatens such expanses of “idle” creativity.（12 分）

中譯英：
①文化是臺灣的關鍵實力。儘管全球競爭激烈，加以國際處境艱難，臺灣的教育水準、人民素質、公民社會、藝文創新，明顯地領先於華人世界，是臺灣最大資產。（13 分）
②人類文明存在一些不同的傳統與哲學的觀點，目的都是一樣的。那就是強化人類的基本價值，人與人之間的愛與同情，還有寬恕、容忍、自我克制等等，這些基本價值都是人心中善的一面。（13 分）
應用文：某博物院近來發現不少參觀遊客服裝不整、大聲喧嘩，影響參觀品質及院方形象，已違反參觀規則，甚至社會秩序維護法。請擬一英文公告，張貼於入口處，籲請遊客避免以上行為，並強調如有情節嚴重，勸止無效者，將由安全人員強制離場，或送法辦。（文長限 150 字）（20 分）

英文作文：Please write an essay no more than 300 words in length to argue for the importance of artand cultural exchange between Taiwan and mainland China. Be sure to give sufficientreasons for your argument.（30 分）
